source: Serge Issakov, "Cardiff 101 Crash List" (crowdsourced; public Google Doc, https://tinyurl.com/cardiff101crashlist)
notes: Advocate reports, not official records. Collected from riders, friends and witnesses, mostly via social media; not independently verified here.
Wording below is condensed from the list; 'where' keeps the list's own location words.
s = metres along the map's road frame, estimated from the landmark named. Every position is approximate. s = null: no usable location.
official = CCRS collision ID when the same crash is in the official data. matchesOfficial = true when the locations agree, so the map shows the official pin only.
Some entries are not bike-vs-infrastructure crashes (a runner, a mirror strike, construction fencing); they are kept because they are on the list.
